t: The Unmetered Robot Army: From Cat Facts to Browser Automation
s: Pipulate evolves from a hardcoded demo to an interactive training platform using local LLMs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This enables unmetered AI experimentation for building robot armies by teaching LLMs structured tool calls via a "Simon Says" game.
sub: Model Context Protocol (MCP): Enabling LLMs for real-world actions
"Simon Says" Game: Interactive LLM training for tool calls
Unmetered AI: Local LLMs vs. cloud-based services
Browser Automation: Demonstrating MCP via interactive workflows
